name: claude-mode
description: Mods for Claude Code (English): a usage band above the prompt, roadmap, branches, context, commands and mods panes, next-step suggestions and a guard for destructive commands

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context fill, memory files, subscription limits (5h and week), response speed and a prompt-cache timer

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Roadmap pane: task stages (context → implementation → checks → tests → push → deploy) marked automatically from Claude's actions, plus Claude's plan

plugins.name: git-branches
plugins.description: GitLens-style Branches pane: local and remote branches, ahead/behind, working-tree changes, GitHub pull requests and recent commits

plugins.name: context-inspector
plugins.description: Context pane: what fills the context window, which MCP servers, skills and memory files use it, and what you can free up

plugins.name: command-deck
plugins.description: Commands pane: the main slash commands, each with a short note on why to use it and a ▶ button to run it in one click

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Above the prompt after a reply: the session goal, what Claude is waiting on from you, and 2–3 next prompts as buttons; 1–3 or a click drafts one

plugins.name: command-guard
plugins.description: Asks before destructive shell commands (rm -r, git push --force, git reset --hard, git clean -f, git branch -D…) and shows what would be lost

plugins.name: mod-switch
plugins.description: “Mods” pane: turn next-steps, the command guard, the band's columns and the roadmap's placement on or off — no commands needed
